rows.commentary: 5.5: Dilshan Madushanka delivers to Tom Banton, who stands tall to punch a boundary wide of mid-off past a scrambling fielder, confirmed after a review by the third umpire.
5.6: Dilshan Madushanka targets outside off with a short of length delivery that Tom Banton punches down directly to mid-off.
6.1: Eshan Malinga sprays a fuller length delivery down the leg side, leaving Ben Duckett swinging and missing as the wide is signaled.
6.1: Eshan Malinga pitches on a length outside off, testing Ben Duckett who simply punches it down toward mid-off.
6.2: Eshan Malinga bowls a good length delivery at 139kph just outside off, which Ben Duckett defends with soft hands into the off-side before cover mops it up.
6.3: Eshan Malinga spears one into the pads on a fuller length, inducing a missed clip from Ben Duckett that ricochets off the inside edge for a single.
6.4: Eshan Malinga extracts sharp skid from a length outside off, beating Tom Banton entirely as he flashes his bat in an attempted punch.
6.5: Eshan Malinga offers a fuller angled-in delivery, and Tom Banton checks his drive perfectly to punch it wide of mid-on for another boundary.
6.6: Eshan Malinga gets an educated edge off a length ball as Tom Banton tries to steer it, dying on its way to the fielder at slip.
7.1: Asitha Fernando clocks in at 128kph, angling onto the pads for Ben Duckett who tucks it firmly down toward mid-wicket.
7.2: Asitha Fernando serves up a fuller length outside off, allowing Ben Duckett to drive cleanly away from mid-off to scamper through for a single.
7.3: Asitha Fernando drops it back of a length outside off, where Tom Banton stands tall with a vertical bat to steer a stunning back-foot drive through point for his seventh boundary.
7.4: Asitha Fernando serves a length delivery outside off, and Tom Banton strides forward to punch it straight back past the bowler for four.
7.5: Asitha Fernando bowls back of a length outside off, inducing an edge from Tom Banton as he looks to punch, resulting in a single after a fumble at third man.
7.6: Asitha Fernando drops it short of a length, and Ben Duckett stabs the ball down into the cover region.
8.1: Eshan Malinga angles one in on a length outside off, prompting Tom Banton to stab it firmly down into the off-side.
8.2: Eshan Malinga delivers a fuller ball angling in, and Tom Banton strokes it straight to the fielder at mid-on.
8.3: Eshan Malinga fires in a yorker that Tom Banton manages to dig out.
8.5: Ben Duckett does not score off Eshan Malinga.
19.6: Dunith Wellalage drops it flatter and shorter, allowing Harry Brook to step back and punch a single down to long-on.
20.1: Dilshan Madushanka angles one in from round the wicket on the back of a length, safely defended by Harry Brook towards point.
20.2: Dilshan Madushanka keeps it short, inviting Harry Brook to tap towards short third and scamper across for a quick single.
20.3: Dilshan Madushanka attacks from a length, pinning Joe Root back to guide the ball toward point.
20.4: Dilshan Madushanka fires a full delivery tailing into the pads, neatly clipped away by Joe Root to short mid-wicket.
20.5: Dilshan Madushanka tests Joe Root with a sharp bouncer, forcing the batsman to skillfully sway out of danger.
20.6: Dilshan Madushanka beats Joe Root with sharp inward seam movement into the pads, prompting an unsuccessful review from Sri Lanka as replays confirm it misses the stumps.
21.1: Kamindu Mendis floats a flatter and shorter delivery that Harry Brook pulls into the gap at long-on for a brisk pair.
21.2: Kamindu Mendis sneaks a quicker delivery past Harry Brook's attempted cut shot.
21.3: Kamindu Mendis tosses this one up nicely, but Harry Brook hits it straight to the fielder stationed at covers.
21.4: Kamindu Mendis drifts a full ball in, prompting Harry Brook to step forward and dead-bat it back to the bowler.
21.5: Kamindu Mendis delivers a touch shorter, allowing Harry Brook to rock back and slice a cut square on the off-side for a single.
21.6: Mendis floats one through shorter as Root rises to slap the square cut for a single.
22.1: Madushanka angles it in from round the wicket and Root simply meets it toward point.
22.2: Madushanka attacks the channel with a wide delivery that Root steers down to deep backward point.
22.3: Madushanka surprises Brook with a towering full toss that finds its way safely to point.
22.4: No run for Harry Brook off Dilshan Madushanka.
34.1: Eshan Malinga delivers a touch fuller around off, punched cleanly through cover by Joe Root to pick up two runs.
34.2: Eshan Malinga pitches up around middle and leg, only for Joe Root to whip the ball straight toward mid-wicket.
34.3: Eshan Malinga attacks from a back of a length around middle and leg, but Joe Root swishes it past a scrambling fielder at backward square leg for a boundary.
34.4: Eshan Malinga tests the batter, resulting in Joe Root chopping the ball down to third man for a single.
34.5: Eshan Malinga drifts a low full toss onto the leg stump, neatly flicked away through square leg by Harry Brook.
34.6: Eshan Malinga bowls a slower ball outside off that stays low, leaving Joe Root grasping at thin air as he misses his drive.
35.1: Dunith Wellalage entices Harry Brook down the pitch, where an inside edge off the drive trickles away toward short fine leg.
35.2: Dunith Wellalage drops a fraction fuller at the stumps, comfortably patted toward cover by Joe Root.
35.3: Dunith Wellalage to Joe Root, he watches the ball like a hawk, advances down the wicket, launches an inside‑out lofted drive that slices through deep extra cover for a four.
35.4: Dunith Wellalage bowls to Joe Root, who goes down on his knee and slogs the ball towards deep mid‑wicket for two runs.
35.5: Dunith Wellalage delivers to Joe Root, a dot ball drifting on the pads before nudging towards the on-side.
35.6: Dunith Wellalage bowls to Joe Root, who sweeps a FOUR to deep backward square‑leg fence.
36.1: Eshan Malinga bowls a yorker length delivery to Harry Brook, who squeezes it towards cover.
36.2: Eshan Malinga delivers a yorker to Harry Brook, who squeezes it back into the blockhole.
36.3: Eshan Malinga bowls to Harry Brook, who moves into the 80s and thumps a length delivery over the bowler’s head for a FOUR.
36.4: Eshan Malinga bowls a low full toss on the pads to Harry Brook, who walks away and whips it over deep mid‑wicket for a SIX.
36.5: Eshan Malinga bowls a full, quick ball outside off to Harry Brook, who slices at it but connects only thin air.
36.6: Eshan Malinga attempts a slower ball to Harry Brook, but it becomes a wide outside off.
36.6: Eshan Malinga bowls a wide to Harry Brook, a slow, wayward delivery that goes outside off.
36.6: Eshan Malinga delivers to Harry Brook, who smashes a FOUR to deep mid‑wicket.
44.5: Eshan Malinga loops a full toss outside off, and Harry Brook slices it over the cover infield for a brisk single.
44.6: Eshan Malinga darts a yorker past Will Jacks, prompting a review from Kusal Mendis that UltraEdge swiftly dismisses as turf noise, exhausting Sri Lanka's reviews.

45.1: Asitha Fernando drifts one onto the pads, allowing Harry Brook to flick it away to the fine leg boundary and eclipse Andrew Strauss's 2011 record for the highest ODI score by an England captain.
45.2: Asitha Fernando angles it in as Harry Brook shapes for a lap, generating an inside edge that thuds into the turf right beside the pitch.
45.3: Asitha Fernando unleashes a pinpoint yorker that whisps past the off stump, leaving Will Jacks completely flailing in his attempt to slice.
45.4: Asitha Fernando offers a full toss outside off, which Will Jacks creams through the off-side to rotate the strike.
45.5: Asitha Fernando pushes full, and Harry Brook dances down the track to launch it cleanly over mid-off for four.
45.6: Asitha Fernando targets the channel, and Harry Brook angles the blade, carving it past backward point to rotate the strike with a single.
46.1: Eshan Malinga fires it wide, and Harry Brook creates room to slice a single down toward deep backward point.
46.2: Eshan Malinga attacks the channel outside off with a yorker, leaving Will Jacks swinging through thin air.
46.3: Eshan Malinga delivers outside off once more, beating Will Jacks as the batter aborts a reverse lap attempt.
46.4: Eshan Malinga errs drastically with the line, spilling one wide enough outside off to signal an obvious extra.
46.4: Eshan Malinga slides one through to Will Jacks, who pushes it firmly toward wide long-off to rotate the strike.
46.5: Eshan Malinga serves up a low full toss outside off, and Harry Brook drops to one knee to lap it away crisply to the backward square leg boundary.
46.6: Eshan Malinga drops it short and wide, allowing Harry Brook to unleash a flat forehand smash racing away to the wide long-off fence.
47.1: Dasun Shanaka pitches it up around off, and Will Jacks launches it cleanly over long-off for a maximum.
47.2: Dasun Shanaka sprays this one short and wide outside off, leaving Will Jacks an easy leave.
47.2: Dasun Shanaka attacks middle and leg with a fuller length, which Will Jacks hoists powerfully over long-on for another six.
47.3: Dasun Shanaka drops one short, Will Jacks meets it with crisp authority, racing away to the fence and bringing up a magnificent fifty.
1.2: Josh Tongue bowls to Avishka Fernando, who takes a length delivery and steers it behind point for a single.
1.3: Josh Tongue bowls an angled ball to Kamindu Mendis, who clips it down to mid-on for no runs.
1.4: Josh Tongue bowls to Kamindu Mendis, who defends a length delivery on the sticks and sends it down into the deck.
1.5: Josh Tongue delivers a fuller ball to Kamindu Mendis, who drives it through the off-side for a four.
1.6: Josh Tongue bowls to Kamindu Mendis, who digs a ball behind the line, leaving no runs.
2.1: Gus Atkinson bowls a pace‑driven ball to Avishka Fernando, who drives it wide of the man at point for two.
2.2: Gus Atkinson bowls a back‑of‑a‑length ball to Avishka Fernando; Fernando defends it into the off‑side.
2.3: Gus Atkinson delivers a length ball to Avishka Fernando, who swings early and sends it a brace wide of mid‑on.
2.4: Gus Atkinson bowls a fuller length ball to Avishka Fernando; Fernando defends it down to mid‑on.
2.5: Gus Atkinson sends a back‑of‑a‑length ball to Avishka Fernando; Fernando hops back and defends it to short mid.
2.6: Gus Atkinson bowls a short‑length ball to Avishka Fernando; Fernando deflects it down the off‑side.
3.1: Josh Tongue bowls
3.2: Josh Tongue bowls a length ball that angles just outside off, which Kamindu Mendis defends down the off‑side for a dot.
3.3: Josh Tongue bowls an angled ball to Kamindu Mendis, who pulls it behind square for a spectacular six.
3.4: Josh Tongue delivers an angled, length ball to Kamindu Mendis, who clips it down to mid‑wicket for a dot.
3.5: Josh Tongue bowls a length ball to Kamindu Mendis, who defends it down the off‑side for a dot.
3.6: Josh Tongue delivers a perfect length ball that slams the top of off, sending Kamindu Mendis out bowled.
4.1: Gus Atkinson bowls a short‑length, outside‑off delivery to Avishka Fernando, who punches it down to point for a dot.
14.6: Jamie Overton charges in at nearly 141 clicks, digging it short down leg for Avishka Fernando to stay back and whip away fine to the boundary.
15.1: Liam Dawson tosses it up to Pavan Rathnayake, who drives it firmly down toward the cover fielder.
15.2: Liam Dawson floats another inviting delivery up, neatly pushed down toward cover by Pavan Rathnayake.
15.3: Pavan Rathnayake plays with soft hands, fencing the delivery down into the off-side to scamper through for a single.
15.4: Liam Dawson drops it full and flat, inviting Avishka Fernando to punch it straight back down the pitch into the bowler's hands for a dot.
15.5: Liam Dawson’s flatter delivery to Avishka Fernando is cut to deep point for a single.
15.6: Liam Dawson bowls a very full ball to Pavan Rathnayake, who drives it straight to cover for no run.
16.1: Sam Curran’s fuller ball to Avishka Fernando is clipped over the wicket to deep mid‑for a brace, his fifty in ODIs.
16.2: Sam Curran delivers a sharp, short ball to Avishka Fernando, who stays back and smashes it down to mid‑off for no run.
16.3: Sam Curran bowls a slower, fuller ball to Avishka Fernando, who pushes it down to mid‑off for no run.
16.4: Sam Curran unleashes a short‑length ball to Avishka Fernando, who whips it down to long‑leg for a four.
16.5: Sam Curran’s fuller delivery finds Avishka Fernando, who drives it to mid‑off where Brook dives, giving a brace.
16.6: Sam Curran bowls a back‑of‑a‑length ball to Avishka Fernando, who punches it to mid‑off and Brook dives to stop it, yielding a single.
17.1: Liam Dawson’s quick delivery finds Avishka Fernando, who tucks it away to deep square‑leg for a single.
17.2: Liam Dawson sends a full, straight ball to Pavan Rathnayake, who nudges it to short mid‑wicket for a single.
17.3: Avishka Fernando dances down the pitch and lofts an inside-out drive over extra cover, where it slips right through the fielder's hands and races away to the fence.
17.4: Liam Dawson delivers to Avishka Fernando, the ball glides to point for a single.
17.5: Pavan Rathnayake does not score off Liam Dawson.
29.6: Jamie Overton angles one in from a back of a length, and Pavan Rathnayake nudges it straight into the hands of short mid-wicket.
30.1: Sam Curran drops pace with a full delivery on middle, inviting Dasun Shanaka to drive it firmly toward mid-off.
30.2: Sam Curran delivers a slower ball on a shorter length, which Dasun Shanaka expertly steers past the fielder to collect three runs.
30.3: Sam Curran comes from round the wicket with a full delivery, and Pavan Rathnayake punches it down the ground toward long-on.
30.4: Sam Curran serves up a full ball on off, prompting Dasun Shanaka to slice his stroke down to deep backward point for a single.
30.5: Sam Curran unleashes a cleverly disguised slower ball, forcing Pavan Rathnayake onto the back foot to bunt it toward short mid-wicket.
30.6: Sam Curran tosses up another slower, fuller delivery, allowing Pavan Rathnayake to ease it down the ground to long-on for a single.
31.1: Liam Dawson fires a full ball into middle, which Pavan Rathnayake drives hard before the bowler reacts sharply to his right to stop it.
31.2: Liam Dawson floats one wide outside off, and Pavan Rathnayake stretches out to punch a single toward sweeper cover.
31.3: Liam Dawson drifts a quicker delivery onto the stumps, and Dasun Shanaka comfortably defends it straight back to the bowler.
31.4: Liam Dawson offers some air, and Dasun Shanaka dances down the track to loft an inside-out drive over the covers for a boundary.
31.5: Liam Dawson pitches it too full on middle, and Dasun Shanaka clears his front leg to launch a massive six deep into the mid-wicket stands.
31.6: Liam Dawson fires in a darting delivery as Dasun Shanaka dead-bats it firmly toward the off-side.
32.1: Sam Curran hides his pace cleverly, leaving Pavan Rathnayake to prod the ball tentatively toward mid-off.
32.2: Sam Curran digs it into the pitch with less pace, allowing Pavan Rathnayake to carve it sharply into sweeper cover.
32.3: Sam Curran strays down the leg side with a short ball, and Dasun Shanaka swivels effortlessly to pull it away for four.
32.4: Sam Curran rolls his fingers over a short delivery, prompting Dasun Shanaka to scramble and push it toward short third.
32.5: Sam Curran digs another slower ball into the pitch, guided smoothly by Dasun Shanaka toward short third.
40.2: Sam Curran extracts the breakthrough as Pavan Rathnayake lofts a length ball straight into the hands of Tom Banton at long-on, ending a magnificent 130-run stay.
40.3: Sam Curran slides one through to mid-off, allowing Janith Liyanage to scamper across for a single.
40.4: Sam Curran digs it in from a back of a length, forcing Dasun Shanaka to knock it straight back down the pitch.
40.5: Sam Curran drifts onto the pads, and Dasun Shanaka neatly tucks it toward short fine leg for a sharp single.
40.6: Sam Curran serves a good length delivery outside off, which Janith Liyanage taps toward mid-off to rotate the strike.
41.1: Will Jacks drags his length back as Janith Liyanage skips down the track and pushes the ball straight back to the bowler.
41.2: Will Jacks drops a low full toss into the area, allowing Janith Liyanage to drive firmly toward long-on for a single.
41.3: Will Jacks fires in a yorker wide of off stump, expertly jammed out toward cover by Dasun Shanaka.
41.4: Will Jacks offers width with a full delivery, and Dasun Shanaka carves it out to deep extra cover to collect a couple of runs.
41.5: Will Jacks attacks the stumps with a fuller trajectory, forcing Dasun Shanaka to hastily dig it into the off-side.
41.6: Dasun Shanaka takes a crisp flick through mid‑wicket for a single off Will Jacks, as the chase lingers 100 runs from 8 overs with only 9 runs in the last two.
42.1: Sam Curran drops short and watches Dasun Shanaka mercilessly pull the delivery high over deep backward square leg for a towering maximum.
42.2: Sam Curran offers width outside off, allowing Dasun Shanaka to slash the ball away through backward point for a single.
42.3: Sam Curran serves it full and wide, and Janith Liyanage drills it cleanly along the carpet to long-off for a single, pushing Sri Lanka to 338/4 compared to England's past mark of 316/3.
42.4: Sam Curran pitches it up around off, and Dasun Shanaka reads the length instantly to launch a massive shot straight over the bowler's head for a maximum that moves him into the nineties.
42.5: Sam Curran fires in a sharp yorker, which Dasun Shanaka manages to squeeze straight back down the pitch to the bowler for no run.

42.6: Sam Curran digs it in short around middle and leg, and Dasun Shanaka swats a flat pull over deep mid-wicket for six to bring up Sri Lanka's 350 and leave himself just a boundary shy of a century.
48.1: Jamie Overton delivers a short, wide outside off that Janith Liyanage slashes over backward point for a crisp single.
48.2: Jamie Overton bowls a short outside off that Dunith Wellalage steers to third man, and a keeper’s end overthrow lets them return for a second run.
48.3: Jamie Overton unleashes a short, quick ball; Dunith Wellalage pulls, ribs hit, but Overton rushes to snatch the chance.
48.4: Jamie Overton delivers a ball that Dunith Wellalage drags through the leg side for a single, leaving 9 runs required from the final eight deliveries.
48.5: Jamie Overton bowls a full, quick outside off; Janith Liyanage attempts a flashy drive but is taken by the keeper at chest height, a dot for England.
48.6: Jamie Overton delivers a full, quick ball over middle and leg that Janith Liyanage drills to long‑on for a single.
49.1: Josh Tongue bowls a slower, short‑sized ball; Janith Liyanage pulls it toward deep mid‑wicket for a single.
49.2: Josh Tongue bowls a pitched‑up round‑the‑wicket delivery; Dunith Wellalage swings wildly, misses, and the ball strikes the middle stump, bowled.
49.3: Josh Tongue unleashes a full, quick ball from round‑the‑wicket; Eshan Malinga swings a straight drive, the ball uproots the middle stump, bowled.
49.4: Josh Tongue delivers a wide outside off; Asitha Fernando slashes away, edges to third man, a fumble deep, and they settle for a single.
49.5: Josh Tongue bowls a pitched‑up delivery; Janith Liyanage powers it over long‑off for a six, sealing Sri Lanka’s historic second‑highest ODI chase.
